name: Leaf Sweeper VR: Cozy Cleanup
summary:
The leaves are piling up, and it’s time to take matters into your own hands! Step into a cozy, relaxing virtual reality where your only goal is to restore order to a beautiful, messy home.

**Leaf Sweeper VR: Cozy Cleanup** is a satisfying cleaning simulator designed from the ground up for VR. Start with just your bare hands and a trash bag, and work your way up to professional-grade leaf blowers and automated vacuum chutes.
